b.title: Global Operations Data Engineer
b.description:
Job Description
Build the trusted data foundation that powers intelligent operations.
Join Agilent's Global OT & AI Engineering organization and help shape the future of digital manufacturing through modern data engineering.
As a Global Operations Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain enterprise data platforms that transform operational data into trusted, reusable, and AI-ready assets. You will build scalable data pipelines, cloud-native data solutions, and enterprise integration services while implementing data governance practices that ensure data quality, consistency, lineage, and reliability across Agilent's global operations.
Working closely with Data Architects, AI & Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, and business stakeholders, you will enable a connected data ecosystem that supports enterprise applications, operational reporting, Artificial Intelligence, Smart Factory initiatives, and executive decision-making.
We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical ownership will be aligned with your experience, expertise, and demonstrated capabilities.
About Global OT & AI Engineering
Global OT & AI Engineering builds the digital foundation that powers Agilent's global manufacturing operations.
Our organization develops enterprise software, AI platforms, cloud-native applications, smart factory technologies, and enterprise data platforms that connect manufacturing sites into one intelligent ecosystem.
Our mission is to transform operational data into trusted insights and intelligent decisions that improve how products are designed, manufactured, tested, and delivered worldwide.
Our portfolio includes:
• Manufacturing AI & Advanced Analytics
• Global Operations Control Tower
• Smart Factory & Industry 4.0
• Enterprise Data Platform
• Digital Twin Solutions
• Manufacturing Knowledge Platform
• AI-powered Decision Support
• Enterprise Data Exchange Platform
About the Role
Modern manufacturing depends on reliable, connected, and trusted data.
Every day, enterprise systems, manufacturing equipment, industrial IoT devices, quality systems, and engineering applications generate vast amounts of operational data. The value of this data depends on the ability to integrate, manage, govern, and deliver it efficiently to the people and systems that rely on it.
As a Global Operations Data Engineer, you will build the enterprise data platform that powers Agilent's digital operations. You will develop scalable data pipelines, implement data governance capabilities, and create reusable data products that enable analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital applications, and operational excellence.
Your work will directly support initiatives such as the Global Operations Control Tower, AI-powered decision support, Smart Factory programs, Digital Twins, and enterprise reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Data Platform Development
• Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise data pipelines that integrate data from Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Procurement, Logistics, Quality, Engineering, ERP, MES, and Industrial IoT platforms.
• Build reusable data products and curated datasets that support enterprise reporting, analytics, AI applications, and digital products.
• Develop cloud-native data solutions that enable secure, scalable, and high-performance access to operational data.
• Optimize data processing, storage, and orchestration to ensure platform reliability and scalability.
Data Integration & Engineering
• Develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines supporting enterprise and operational systems.
• Design APIs and integration services that enable seamless data exchange across enterprise applications.
• Implement batch, streaming, and event-driven data processing architectures.
• Collaborate with Software Engineers to expose trusted data through APIs and enterprise services.
• Support enterprise integration across SAP, MES, PLM, Quality Systems, cloud platforms, and operational technologies.
Data Governance & Quality
• Implement enterprise data governance standards and best practices defined by the Data Architecture team.
• Develop automated data quality validation, monitoring, reconciliation, and exception handling processes.
• Maintain enterprise metadata, data lineage, and catalog information to improve discoverability and traceability.
• Support Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives by ensuring consistency of critical business data.
• Monitor enterprise data quality metrics and proactively resolve data integrity issues.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify Critical Data Elements (CDEs) and improve data reliability across operational systems.
• Promote governance practices that ensure enterprise data remains accurate, secure, trusted, and fit for business use.
AI & Analytics Enablement
• Prepare and maintain AI-ready datasets supporting Machine Learning and advanced analytics.
• Collaborate with AI & Data Scientists to develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable analytical datasets.
• Support semantic data models that enable self-service reporting and enterprise analytics.
• Improve accessibility, consistency, and reuse of enterprise data across digital products and AI platforms.
Platform Reliability & Continuous Improvement
• Monitor the health, availability, and performance of enterprise data pipelines and services.
• Implement observability, logging, monitoring, and alerting capabilities for critical data platforms.
• Apply DevOps and CI/CD best practices to automate deployment, testing, and operational support.
• Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and engineering practices to improve the enterprise data platform.
Cross-functional Collaboration
• Partner with Data Architects to implement enterprise data architecture, standards, and integration strategies.
• Collaborate with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, and IT teams to understand business requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
• Work closely with Software Engineers and AI teams to integrate trusted data into enterprise applications and intelligent solutions.
• Support enterprise digital transformation initiatives across Agilent's global operations.
Technology Environment
You will work with a modern enterprise technology stack, including:
Programming & Data Engineering
• Python
• SQL
• Apache Spark
• dbt
Cloud & Data Platforms
• Microsoft Azure
• AWS
• Microsoft Fabric
• Azure Data Lake
• Snowflake
Integration & Streaming
• REST APIs
• Azure Event Hub
• Apache Kafka
• Data Factory
Enterprise Systems
• SAP ERP / S/4HANA
• SAP ME / MES
• PLM
• Quality Management Systems
• Industrial IoT Platforms
Data Governance
• Microsoft Purview
• Master Data Management (MDM)
• Data Catalog
• Metadata Management
• Data Lineage
• Data Quality Monitoring
DevOps
• GitHub
• Azure DevOps
• Docker
Analytics
• Power BI
• Microsoft Fabric
• Streamlit (preferred)
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
We welcome candidates across multiple career stages. Responsibilities and technical leadership will be aligned with your experience and demonstrated capability.
You should have:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Data Integration, or Enterprise Data Platforms.
• Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
• Experience building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cloud-based data solutions.
• Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, API integration, and enterprise data management principles.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
• Passion for building modern data platforms that enable digital transformation.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in one or more of the following areas is advantageous:
• Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, or Enterprise Operations
• Cloud-native Data Platforms (Azure, AWS, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric)

• Event-driven Data Processing

About the Role
We are looking for a highly technical Software Engineer to strengthen the security, compliance, and quality assurance of our enterprise-grade Generative AI and agent orchestration platform.
The primary focus of this role is AI security assurance: implementing and operating Moonshot and Litmus testing, conducting adversarial and risk-based assessments of LLM and agentic applications, translating compliance requirements into practical controls, and advising internal stakeholders on secure data handling and solution architecture. Software test automation remains an important secondary responsibility to support reliable product delivery.
This role suits an engineer who can combine hands-on security testing with sound architectural judgement, communicate risk clearly, and work collaboratively with product, engineering, security, governance, and business teams.
Responsibilities
AI Security, Compliance & Architecture:
• AI Security Testing:Design and execute AI-specific security and safety assessments for LLM, RAG, and agentic applications, covering threats such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive-data disclosure, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool misuse, and cross-tenant data exposure. Conventional application penetration testing is performed by third-party providers and is outside the primary scope of this role.

Advise internal stakeholders on secure use of enterprise and sensitive data in GenAI solutions, including data flows, access controls, tenant isolation, retrieval boundaries, logging, retention, model or service selection, and third-party integration risks. Support risk assessments, security reviews, audit responses, remediation plans, and go-live assurance activities.
• Secure Solution Architecture:Review proposed AI solution designs, identify security and privacy risks, recommend proportionate controls, and collaborate with engineering and architecture teams to embed security by design throughout the solution lifecycle.
• Security Findings, Remediation & Reporting:Document vulnerabilities and control gaps with clear risk, impact, evidence, and remediation guidance. Work with delivery teams to track and validate fixes, communicate residual risk to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and report assurance metrics, recurring findings, and risk trends.
• Security Automation & Release Assurance:Integrate automated AI security and evaluation tests into CI/CD pipelines and release processes. Define security regression checks, release gates, and acceptance criteria to identify material risks before production deployment.
Software Test Automation:
• Test Automation:Build and maintain automated functional, regression, API, and end-to-end tests using suitable frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, or Postman.
• Defect Investigation:Reproduce issues, trace application and cloud logs, isolate root causes, and provide actionable defect reports to engineering teams.
• Quality Enablement:Promote pragmatic testing practices, reusable test assets, and shared ownership of quality across product and engineering teams.
Requirements

• AI Security Knowledge:Practical understanding of security and safety risks affecting LLM, RAG, and agentic applications, including prompt injection, data leakage, unsafe tool use, excessive permissions, insecure output handling, and model or application abuse.
• AI Testing Toolkits:Hands-on experience with Moonshot, Litmus, or comparable AI evaluation, red-teaming, benchmarking, or adversarial-testing tools; ability to design custom scenarios and interpret results.
• Security & Compliance:Ability to interpret security, privacy, and AI governance requirements and translate them into technical controls, test plans, risk assessments, and assurance evidence.
• Solution Architecture:Experience reviewing system designs and data flows, assessing trust boundaries and integration risks, and recommending secure, proportionate architectures for cloud-based applications.
• Stakeholder Consulting:Strong communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to explain technical risks, challenge assumptions constructively, and guide internal stakeholders towards secure implementation decisions.

• Cloud & Data:Familiarity with AWS services, containerised environments, SQL databases, access controls, logging, encryption, data classification, masking, retention, and secure handling of sensitive information.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience conducting AI red-team exercises, AI threat modelling, or AI security and application assurance reviews.
• Familiarity with recognised AI and application security guidance, such as the OWASP GenAI Security Project, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, or MITRE ATLAS.
• Experience testing RAG pipelines, model integrations, agent tools, sandboxes, RBAC, tenant-isolation controls, and other AI-specific attack surfaces.
• Familiarity with government enterprise environments and high-security data compliance requirements, including IM8.

The Risk Platform team at Airwallex is responsible for managing the risk for all the products at Airwallex, including GTPN, PA, Issuing, Onboarding, and Account takeover. We collaborate with other teams and our customers globally to ensure a holistic approach for risk management.
This role is based in Singapore.

You’ll own critical parts of our real-time detection platform and client-facing risk and fraud management products, setting the technical direction and raising the engineering bar while working closely with your manager and cross-functional partners.

• Lead the technical direction of core risk services, including real-time detection, decision engines, and risk tooling, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient under high throughput and low-latency constraints.

Company Overview
Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.
We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.
And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.
We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.
Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.
Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.
Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.
With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.
Join us in building the power foundation of the future!
Role Summary
This role is an opportunity to work with a high-agency startup team operating in the hard-tech and energy systems space. You will play a critical role in designing, building, and shipping the full stack of Amperesand’s ERP platform, company intranet, and the internal tools that our manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and corporate teams rely on every day.
This is a hands-on role that spans the entire stack. You will design data models and backend services, then build the React and TypeScript interfaces that sit on top of them — owning features end to end from requirements through production. The work covers ERP domains such as inventory, procurement, work orders, and reporting, alongside intranet capabilities such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal workflows, approvals, and self-service tools. You will also help introduce AI-assisted capabilities into these products, such as natural-language search over internal knowledge, document summarization, and workflow assistance.
The role requires close collaboration with product, design, backend, and domain expert teams — along with a strong sense of ownership, product judgment, and pragmatism in building reliable software for real-world operations. Beyond building new capabilities, you will also own and support our existing software products in production — keeping them healthy, responsive, and continuously improving for the internal stakeholders and customers who depend on them daily. This is a fast-paced environment with a small team and a large surface area, so we are looking for a go-getter who takes initiative, moves with urgency, and is willing to put in the hard work to see things through. AI is a first-class part of this roadmap rather than a side project: you will design and ship AI-powered capabilities integrated directly into the products themselves, and help set the standard for how we build them responsibly on top of sensitive internal company data.
This role is open at either the Senior or Staff level. Senior engineers are expected to own significant features and systems end to end and lift the engineers around them. Staff engineers are expected to do that while also setting technical direction across the ERP, MES, and intranet platforms, leading initiatives that span multiple teams, and taking responsibility for the long-term health of the architecture. We will calibrate the level to your experience during the interview process.
Responsibilities
• Own the design, architecture, and delivery of full stack features across Amperesand’s ERP platform, intranet, and internal operational tools.
• Build and scale backend services in Go that support mission-critical manufacturing, supply chain, and enterprise business workflows.
• Build responsive, accessible, and performant web interfaces in React and TypeScript that make complex operational data understandable and actionable.
• Design robust APIs, service interfaces, and data models that serve web applications, analytics systems, internal tools, and third-party enterprise integrations.
• Deliver ERP capabilities spanning inventory management, procurement, supply chain operations, work order execution, production tracking, and enterprise reporting.
• Build intranet features such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal announcements, approval and request workflows, onboarding flows, and self-service portals.
• Integrate the intranet and ERP with internal systems such as identity and SSO providers, HR systems, document storage, and collaboration tools.
• Design, build, and ship AI-powered features directly into our ERP and intranet products — natural-language search and Q&A over company knowledge, document understanding and data extraction, summarization, exception and anomaly flagging, and assistant-style workflows that remove manual operational work.
• Build the backend foundations behind those features: retrieval and embedding pipelines, vector and hybrid search, context assembly from ERP and intranet data, prompt orchestration, and tool/function calling into existing services.

b.description:
About the team
The Risk Platform team at Airwallex is responsible for managing the risk for all the products at Airwallex, including GTPN, PA, Issuing, Onboarding, and Account takeover. The risk landscape is constantly changing, and fraudsters are becoming increasingly sophisticated. We are at the forefront of innovation in risk management.
Our mission is to keep Airwallex's products and services safe and secure, and make Airwallex a trusted partner for businesses around the world. We use cutting-edge technologies, such as graph, ML, and LLM, to implement and improve our strategy.
We collaborate with other teams and our customers globally to ensure a holistic approach for risk management.
This role is based in Singapore.
What you’ll do
As a Staff Engineer on the Risk Platform, you will be a senior technical leader and hands-on builder. You’ll own critical parts of our real-time detection platform and client-facing risk and fraud management products, setting the technical direction and raising the engineering bar while working closely with your manager and cross-functional partners.
You will:
• Lead the technical direction of core risk services, including real-time detection, decision engines, and risk tooling, ensuring they are reliable, scalable, and cost-efficient under high throughput and low-latency constraints.
• Design and evolve system architecture for distributed, event-driven risk systems (microservices, streaming pipelines, feature stores, model serving layers) that support global products and regulatory requirements.
• Own end-to-end delivery of complex initiatives: from high-level design and technical specifications, to implementation, rollout strategies, and continuous improvement.
• Be deeply hands-on in code and design, writing high-quality production code (primarily in Java/Spring Boot) and driving high-impact design reviews, RFCs, and architecture discussions.
• Partner closely with the Engineering Manager and Product Manager to shape the roadmap, define technical milestones, and translate business and risk objectives into robust engineering solutions.
• Champion engineering excellence by defining and enforcing standards for code quality, observability, reliability, security, and performance across the Risk Platform stack.
• Improve detection effectiveness by working with data and ML teams to integrate models, rules, and features into production systems, and by designing experimentation and evaluation capabilities.
• Drive operational excellence by improving on-call readiness, incident response, postmortems, SLIs/SLOs, capacity planning, and resilience patterns (graceful degradation, fallbacks, retries, timeouts, backpressure).
• Mentor and uplevel other engineers, including senior ICs: provide technical coaching, pair programming, design guidance, and feedback that helps them do the best work of their careers.
• Collaborate across teams (platform, data, SRE, security, and other product engineering teams) to define clear interfaces, SLAs, and ownership boundaries for shared services and infrastructure.
• Identify and pay down technical debt deliberately, balancing short-term impact with long-term platform health and enabling faster, safer delivery over time.
Who you are
We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but not strictly required.
Minimum qualifications
• 7+ years of back-end engineering experience, including substantial time owning and operating complex, distributed systems in production.
• Deep experience in risk, fraud, or fintech systems (e.g., payments, banking, trading, or similar high-stakes domains where correctness and reliability are critical).
• Strong proficiency in Java, including multi-threading, high-concurrency patterns, performance tuning, and networked service design (I/O/NIO, HTTP/TCP, REST).
• Hands-on experience with distributed system design, including event-driven architectures, partitioning/sharding, consistency models, caching strategies, and resiliency patterns.
• Proficiency with Spring / Spring Boot and build tools such as Gradle or Maven.
• Practical experience with containerization and orchestration, particularly Docker and Kubernetes, in production environments.
• Solid understanding of observability and operations: logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and incident management for large-scale systems.
• Ability to lead complex technical initiatives end-to-end, influencing engineers and stakeholders without relying on formal management authority.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
• Experience with risk-specific components, such as rule engines, feature stores, model serving frameworks, real-time stream processing, and A/B testing / experimentation platforms.
• Working knowledge of machine learning in production, including model lifecycle, feature engineering, evaluation metrics, and online/offline consistency.
• Experience with modern data and storage technologies, such as Cassandra, Redis, NoSQL databases, Hadoop, and streaming systems like Kafka, Flink, or Spark.
• Polyglot engineering experience with one or more of Kotlin, Scala, Python, or Golang.
• Cloud experience with Alibaba Cloud, AWS, or GCP, including cloud networking, security best practices, and cost awareness.
• Familiarity with regulatory and security standards relevant to payments and financial services (e.g., PCI DSS, SOC 2, data privacy and protection best practices).
• Demonstrated impact as a Staff or Principal Engineer (or equivalent) in high-growth, high-scale environments.

As a Global Operations Data Engineer, you will build the enterprise data platform that powers Agilent's digital operations. You will develop scalable data pipelines, implement data governance capabilities, and create reusable data products that enable analytics, Artificial Intelligence, digital applications, and operational excellence.

b.title: Staff Software Engineer: Agentic Factory and Operations Software
b.location: D05 Pasir Panjang, Hong Leong Garden, Clementi New Town, Singapore
b.description:
Company Overview
Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.
We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.
And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.
We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.
Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.
Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.
Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.
With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.
Join us in building the power foundation of the future!
Role Summary
This role is an opportunity to work with a high-agency startup team operating in the hard-tech and energy systems space. You will play a critical role in designing, building, and shipping the full stack of Amperesand’s ERP platform, company intranet, and the internal tools that our manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and corporate teams rely on every day.
This is a hands-on role that spans the entire stack. You will design data models and backend services, then build the React and TypeScript interfaces that sit on top of them — owning features end to end from requirements through production. The work covers ERP domains such as inventory, procurement, work orders, and reporting, alongside intranet capabilities such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal workflows, approvals, and self-service tools. You will also help introduce AI-assisted capabilities into these products, such as natural-language search over internal knowledge, document summarization, and workflow assistance.
The role requires close collaboration with product, design, backend, and domain expert teams — along with a strong sense of ownership, product judgment, and pragmatism in building reliable software for real-world operations. Beyond building new capabilities, you will also own and support our existing software products in production — keeping them healthy, responsive, and continuously improving for the internal stakeholders and customers who depend on them daily. This is a fast-paced environment with a small team and a large surface area, so we are looking for a go-getter who takes initiative, moves with urgency, and is willing to put in the hard work to see things through. AI is a first-class part of this roadmap rather than a side project: you will design and ship AI-powered capabilities integrated directly into the products themselves, and help set the standard for how we build them responsibly on top of sensitive internal company data.
This role is open at either the Senior or Staff level. Senior engineers are expected to own significant features and systems end to end and lift the engineers around them. Staff engineers are expected to do that while also setting technical direction across the ERP, MES, and intranet platforms, leading initiatives that span multiple teams, and taking responsibility for the long-term health of the architecture. We will calibrate the level to your experience during the interview process.
Responsibilities
• Own the design, architecture, and delivery of full stack features across Amperesand’s ERP platform, intranet, and internal operational tools.
• Build and scale backend services in Go that support mission-critical manufacturing, supply chain, and enterprise business workflows.
• Build responsive, accessible, and performant web interfaces in React and TypeScript that make complex operational data understandable and actionable.
• Design robust APIs, service interfaces, and data models that serve web applications, analytics systems, internal tools, and third-party enterprise integrations.
• Deliver ERP capabilities spanning inventory management, procurement, supply chain operations, work order execution, production tracking, and enterprise reporting.
• Build intranet features such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal announcements, approval and request workflows, onboarding flows, and self-service portals.
• Integrate the intranet and ERP with internal systems such as identity and SSO providers, HR systems, document storage, and collaboration tools.
• Design, build, and ship AI-powered features directly into our ERP and intranet products — natural-language search and Q&A over company knowledge, document understanding and data extraction, summarization, exception and anomaly flagging, and assistant-style workflows that remove manual operational work.
• Build the backend foundations behind those features: retrieval and embedding pipelines, vector and hybrid search, context assembly from ERP and intranet data, prompt orchestration, and tool/function calling into existing services.
• Integrate LLM providers and AI services into production systems with attention to latency, cost, caching, rate limits, fallback behavior, and graceful degradation when a model is slow, unavailable, or wrong.
• Design AI experiences that fit enterprise software — streaming responses, citations back to source records, clear handling of uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop review before any action is committed to the system of record.
• Apply guardrails for AI operating on internal company data, including permission-aware retrieval, access control, PII handling, auditability, and prevention of data leakage across teams.
• Partner with the AI team to evaluate models, build eval sets and quality metrics, and take promising prototypes all the way into supported, production-grade product features.
• Continuously evaluate where AI can meaningfully reduce manual effort across ERP and intranet workflows — and where a conventional solution is the better answer.
• Support, maintain, and continuously improve our existing ERP, MES, and intranet software products in production — triaging issues, diagnosing root causes, and shipping fixes and enhancements alongside new feature development, including time-sensitive issues that block production on the shop floor.
• Serve as a technical point of contact for internal stakeholders and customers using our platforms, responding to requests, unblocking users, and turning their feedback into prioritized product improvements.
• Build systems that are reliable, observable, secure, and resilient under production load, with appropriate attention to authentication, authorization, and data privacy for internal enterprise data.
• Optimize performance across both frontend rendering and backend latency, throughput, and data access patterns.
• Collaborate closely with product, design, and domain teams to translate operational requirements into well-scoped, well-architected software.
• Drive best practices for code quality, testing, deployment, reliability, and maintainability across the stack.
• Contribute to — and at the Staff level, help set — technical strategy and architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and platform layers.
• Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and strong engineering standards.
• Lead multi-quarter technical initiatives that cross team and system boundaries, breaking them into deliverable milestones and keeping them on track.
• Establish and evolve engineering standards, patterns, and shared foundations that raise the quality and velocity of the whole team.
• Act as a force multiplier: grow other engineers, improve how the team works, and step into the hardest or most ambiguous problems on the roadmap.
• Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to shape the ERP, MES, and intranet roadmap, and to make pragmatic build, buy, and sequencing calls.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools where useful to improve engineering velocity, code quality, and developer productivity.
• Document designs, architecture decisions, and tradeoffs for cross-functional stakeholders.
Qualifications
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping full stack web applications to production.
• Demonstrated technical leadership without formal authority — driving alignment on designs, raising the engineering bar, and unblocking others. At the Staff level, this includes owning the architecture of a major platform area end to end.
• Strong experience building production backend services, ideally in Go; strong engineers from other typed backend languages who are eager to work in Go are welcome.
• Strong frontend experience with React and TypeScript, including modern component patterns, state management, and building complex data-dense interfaces such as tables, forms, dashboards, and workflow builders.
• Solid understanding of API design, relational data modeling, authentication and authorization, and service integration patterns.
• Experience building enterprise or internal software such as ERP, MES, intranet, workflow, admin, or business operations platforms.
• Hands-on experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) — building, extending, integrating with, or supporting them in a production manufacturing environment.
• Working knowledge of core MES domains such as work order and routing execution, electronic travelers and work instructions, WIP and production tracking, operator and station interfaces, labor and material consumption, and shop-floor data collection.
• Understanding of quality and traceability requirements in manufacturing software — in-process inspections, non-conformance and CAPA handling, serialization, unit genealogy, and as-built records.
• Familiarity with MES-to-ERP integration patterns, including synchronization of work orders, BOMs and routings, inventory and material movements, and production status between systems.
• Exposure to equipment and shop-floor integration — machine, PLC, SCADA, or IoT data collection — and to production metrics such as OEE, yield, cycle time, and downtime tracking.
• Experience with databases and data systems such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, or similar technologies, including schema design and query optimization.
• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and containerized deployment environments such as AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker.
• Experience with observability and production operations, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and incident debugging.
• Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end validation.
• Comfortable working with AI coding tools such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools to supplement and accelerate development.
• Hands-on experience integrating LLM or AI APIs into production application features — such as retrieval-augmented search, summarization, structured data extraction, or tool-calling workflows — along with sound judgment about where AI is and is not the right solution.
• Working understanding of retrieval and grounding techniques (embeddings, vector or hybrid search, chunking, context assembly) and of prompt design, evaluation, and iteration.
• Ability to work directly with non-technical stakeholders to gather requirements and turn ambiguous operational problems into shipped software.
• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment — a self-starter and go-getter who takes initiative, moves quickly without waiting to be told what to do, and is willing to put in the hard work required to ship on aggressive timelines.
• Comfortable balancing new product development with ongoing support of live systems, and able to reprioritize as business needs shift.
• Proficiency in English and ability to communicate effectively with wider teams.
• Ability to travel up to 20%, including international.
Bonus Qualifications
• Hands-on experience shipping LLM or AI-powered features in production applications — for example retrieval-augmented generation, semantic or hybrid search, document understanding, structured data extraction, or assistant- and agent-style workflows.
• Familiarity with embeddings and vector search tools such as pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, or similar, including chunking strategies, indexing, and retrieval quality tuning.
• Experience with function and tool calling, agent frameworks, or protocols such as MCP that let AI systems act safely against existing APIs and services.
• Experience building evaluation and observability for AI features — eval sets, quality metrics, human review loops, prompt versioning, and regression tracking.
• Experience with model selection and cost/latency tradeoffs, or with fine-tuning and adapting models for domain-specific tasks.
• Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, supply chain, inventory management, energy systems, or other operational technology domains.
• Background in energy engineering systems (power systems, energy storage, power electronics, or controls).
• Experience with enterprise identity, SSO, SAML/OIDC, or role-based access control at scale.
• Experience working within or building design systems and shared component libraries.
• Experience with real-time data, telemetry pipelines, or dashboards and reporting systems.
• Experience integrating with machines, PLCs, IoT devices, or external enterprise platforms.
• Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and software DevOps practices.
• Experience working with hardware, firmware, or operations teams.
• Open-source contributions a plus.
Please note:This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.
Onsite Collaboration Rationale:
Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.
Why Join Amperesand
• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems
• High ownership and visibility
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure
• Fast-moving startup environment

a.description:
Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 millionbusinessesbuild on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We makeupgrades to our productsevery single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the mostreliable APIson the internet. We build entirely newpiecesoffinancialinfrastructureto enable new ideas. And our significant advances inrisk and fraudinfrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.
Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.
What you'll do
As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.
Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.
Responsibilities
• Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.
• Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.
• Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions
• Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.
• Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.
Who you are
• Ambitious builder:You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.
• Rigorous thinker:You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.
• Adaptable problem solver:You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.
Minimum requirements
• A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline.
• Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.
• Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.
• Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.
• Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.
Preferred qualifications
• At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.
• One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.
• Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.
• Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.
• Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

b.location: D05 Pasir Panjang, Hong Leong Garden, Clementi New Town, Singapore
b.description:
Company Overview
Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.
We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.
And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.
We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.
Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.
Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.
Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.
With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.
Join us in building the power foundation of the future!
Role Summary
This role is an opportunity to grow as an engineer alongside a high-agency startup team operating in the hard-tech and energy systems space. You will build features across the full stack of Amperesand’s ERP platform, company intranet, and the internal tools our manufacturing, supply chain, and corporate teams use every day.
This is a hands-on, build-focused role. You will implement backend services and the React and TypeScript interfaces that sit on top of them, working on well-scoped features with support and mentorship from senior engineers. The work covers ERP domains such as inventory, procurement, work orders, and reporting, alongside intranet capabilities such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal workflows, and self-service tools — with opportunities to contribute to AI-assisted features as they roll out. You will be expected to take ownership of your work, ask good questions, and grow steadily toward independently owning larger pieces of the platform. You will also help support our existing software products in production — fixing bugs, handling requests from internal stakeholders and customers, and making steady improvements to the tools people rely on daily. This is a fast-paced environment, and we are looking for a go-getter who takes initiative, moves with urgency, and is willing to put in the hard work to see things through. AI features are a growing part of this roadmap, and you will get hands-on experience building them into real products — from retrieval and prompting through to the interface — alongside senior and AI team engineers.
Responsibilities
• Implement full stack features across Amperesand’s ERP platform, intranet, and internal operational tools, with guidance from senior engineers on architecture and scope.
• Build backend services and APIs in Go that support manufacturing, supply chain, and enterprise business workflows.
• Build responsive and accessible web interfaces in React and TypeScript, including forms, tables, dashboards, and internal workflow screens.
• Contribute to ERP capabilities such as inventory management, procurement, work order tracking, and enterprise reporting.
• Contribute to intranet features such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal announcements, approval and request workflows, and self-service portals.
• Support integrations with internal systems such as identity and SSO providers, HR systems, document storage, and collaboration tools.
• Build AI-powered features into our ERP and intranet products — such as natural-language search over company knowledge, document summarization, data extraction from forms and documents, and assistant-style helpers embedded in existing workflows.
• Implement the supporting pieces behind those features: retrieval and embedding pipelines, integrations with LLM provider APIs, prompt templates, and the frontend patterns that present AI output clearly and honestly to users.
• Help make AI features production-ready — handling errors and slow responses, adding citations back to source records, respecting user permissions on retrieved data, and testing output quality before release.
• Learn from senior and AI team engineers as you take on more of this work, and bring your own ideas for where AI could remove manual effort for our teams.
• Support and maintain our existing ERP, MES, and intranet software products in production — investigating reported issues, fixing bugs, and delivering enhancements requested by internal stakeholders and customers, including issues raised from the shop floor.
• Respond to stakeholder and customer questions about the tools you work on, and help translate their feedback into concrete improvements.
• Write clear, well-tested, maintainable code and participate actively in code reviews.
• Help debug, monitor, and improve services in production, including responding to issues and improving observability.
• Work with product, design, and domain teams to clarify requirements and turn them into working software.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Copilot, Cursor, or Claude to improve your velocity and code quality.
• Document what you build so teammates and cross-functional stakeholders can pick it up.
• Continuously grow your technical depth through mentorship, design discussions, and increasing ownership over time.
Qualifications
• 2+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping web applications to production.
• Working experience across both backend and frontend development, or strong depth on one side with genuine interest in growing into the other.
• Experience with a typed backend language — Go preferred; experience in Go, Java, TypeScript/Node, Rust, or similar with willingness to work in Go is welcome.
• Experience building web interfaces with React and TypeScript.
• Solid fundamentals in REST or gRPC API design, relational databases such as PostgreSQL, and version control with Git.
• Experience with databases and data systems such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, or similar technologies, including schema design and query optimization.
• Experience with, or exposure to, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) — building, extending, integrating with, or supporting manufacturing or shop-floor software.
• Familiarity with core MES concepts such as work order and routing execution, electronic travelers and work instructions, WIP and production tracking, operator and station interfaces, and shop-floor data collection.
• Understanding of quality and traceability basics in manufacturing software — in-process inspections, non-conformances, serialization, and unit genealogy — or a strong interest in learning them.
• Interest in MES-to-ERP integration, including how work orders, BOMs, inventory movements, and production status flow between systems.
• Understanding of testing practices and a habit of writing tests alongside code.
• Familiarity with cloud environments and containerized deployment such as AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
• Comfortable working with AI coding tools such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools to supplement and accelerate development.
• Some hands-on exposure to building with LLM or AI APIs — for example retrieval-augmented search, summarization, or structured extraction — or a clear interest and demonstrated aptitude for picking it up quickly.
• Willingness to learn retrieval, prompting, and evaluation techniques, and to think critically about when AI output is accurate and trustworthy enough to ship.
• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and willingness to ask questions and seek feedback.
• Thrives in a fast-paced startup environment — a self-starter and go-getter who takes initiative, moves quickly, and is willing to put in the hard work required to ship.
• Comfortable switching between new feature work and supporting live systems as priorities shift.
• Proficiency in English and ability to communicate effectively with wider teams.
• Ability to travel up to 20%, including international.
Bonus Qualifications
• Exposure to enterprise or internal software such as ERP, MES, intranet, admin, or business operations tools.
• Experience shipping LLM or AI-powered application features such as semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, summarization, document understanding, or assistant-style workflows.
• Familiarity with embeddings and vector search tools such as pgvector, Qdrant, Pinecone, or similar.
• Exposure to prompt engineering, function and tool calling, or evaluating the quality of AI-generated output.
• Interest or background in manufacturing, supply chain, industrial automation, or energy systems.
• Experience working within a design system or shared component library.
• Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and software DevOps practices.
• Experience with dashboards, reporting, or data visualization.
• Internships, side projects, or open-source contributions that show breadth across the stack.
Please note:This role requires working on-site 5 days a week. We do not offer hybrid or remote options.
Onsite Collaboration Rationale:
Given the highly collaborative and cross-functional nature of hardware, embedded systems, and product development, in-person partnership across engineering and product teams is critical to enabling rapid execution, technical alignment, and successful development outcomes.
Why Join Amperesand
• Work on next-generation power infrastructure systems
• High ownership and visibility
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Opportunity to shape future products and infrastructure
• Fast-moving startup environment
Pay Disclosure & Benefits
Compensation will be determined based on experience, location, and other factors permitted by law.
Singapore-based employees receive benefits in accordance with local government provisions.
Candidate Confidentiality & Information Protection
As part of our commitment to protecting confidential and proprietary information, candidates should not disclose or provide Amperesand with any confidential, proprietary, or trade secret information belonging to a current or former employer or any other third party during the application or interview process.
Please do not submit or present employer-owned source code, schematics, designs, technical documentation, internal presentations, customer information, prototypes, or other confidential materials. Candidates should discuss their experience and accomplishments at an appropriate level and use only information and materials they are authorized to share.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Amperesand is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law.

b.title: Senior /Software Engineer (Fullstack)
b.description:
Senior /Software Engineer (Fullstack)
Be part of something.
Every time a shipment moves,
Yojee
makes it visible, intelligent, and efficient.
We’re not building dashboards for clicks. We’re building technology that actually moves the world — optimising how freight flows across air, ocean and road.
Logistics is a global industry with real operational complexity. With MOSAIC and TCMS, we are building products that handle real-time events, high data volume, and mission-critical workflows.
If you're a senior fullstack engineer who wants to own product features end-to-end
— from problem framing, through Elixir services and React interfaces, to production health — this role is for you.
The Opportunity
We're hiring an experienced
Software Engineer (Fullstack)
to take ownership of significant product surfaces — backend through frontend — inside our product squads.
You'll work closely with product, design, and other engineers as a
product engineer
: someone who owns the why as much as the what. You'll deliver vertical slices across Elixir / Phoenix services and React / TypeScript interfaces, set the quality bar across both halves of the stack, and shape the patterns the wider team relies on — not just ship features.
This isn't brochureware or content management. You'll be working on enterprise-grade, data-intensive applications where performance and state management matter to global logistics networks.
Agentic AI is a real part of how we work — across our SDLC and inside the product. We use coding agents, agentic prompting, and MCP-based tooling in day-to-day delivery, and we're building native agentic AI into the platform itself, not a bolted-on chatbot. You'll grow your craft inside that environment, not separate from it.
What You’ll Do
• Own Features End-to-End, Across the Stack:Take features from problem definition through Elixir / Phoenix services, React / TypeScript UI, rollout, and post-launch health — work is not done when the PR merges. Make sound architectural decisions across both halves of the stack, and push back constructively when a brief is unclear or solving the wrong problem.
• Set the Quality Bar:Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code that others reference as the standard — on both sides of the stack. Give substantive code reviews — including on AI-generated code — that catch real issues and measurably improve the work.
• Shape Shared Foundations:Lead the design and evolution of patterns, abstractions, and shared components — backend modules, frontend libraries, integration points — that let other engineers contribute effectively across the stack. Improve performance, observability, and developer experience as deliberate outcomes, not side effects.
• Drive Squad-Level Technical Decisions:Contribute resolutions in architecture and engineering standards conversations — backed with clear reasoning, updated with new information. Influence how other engineers approach problems through code, reviews, and technical discussion.
• Multiply the Team:Onboard and informally mentor more junior engineers as a natural part of how you work. Translate technical context clearly for product, design, and non-engineers; keep async communication (PRs, design docs, Slack) complete enough that the team can act without follow-up.
• Own the User Problem:Operate as a product engineer — understand the user problem and business rationale behind features, use data to validate that what shipped actually works, and propose the right scope rather than executing the requested scope blindly.
• Use AI Deliberately:Accelerate good work with coding agents, agentic prompting, and MCP-based tooling — applied to backend and frontend alike. Recognise and manage the risk in your own work and in what you review.
What You’ll Bring
• 6+ Years of Experience:Building, shipping, and owning modern production web applications across both backend and frontend — including responsibility for production health, not just initial delivery.
• Backend Depth:Strong functional backgrounds experience (commercial or substantial open-source), considered if Elixir adoption is realistic for you. Solid understanding of distributed systems or event-driven architectures, relational databases (PostgreSQL ideal), and operational concerns (CI/CD, observability, performance).
• Frontend Depth:Strong React, TypeScript, JavaScript, and solid CSS fundamentals. Comfortable with state management, performance tuning, accessibility, and testing strategy in data-dense interfaces.
• Senior Data-Intensive Knowledge:Track record on complex enterprise web applications (ERPs, trading platforms, logistics or operational systems) where state, latency, and edge cases matter — not content-heavy or CMS-driven projects.
• The Scaffolder Mindset, At Scale:Hands-on experience designing and evolving patterns, libraries, and CI/CD pipelines that make other engineers faster and safer. You've set a quality bar others adopt — on either side of the stack, ideally both.
• Product and Commercial Context:Make engineering decisions with the user problem, business rationale, and maintainability in mind — not just the ticket. Able to articulate technical debt and trade-offs in terms non-engineers can act on.
• Ownership and Judgement:Operate effectively when problems are ambiguous: break them down into executable work for yourself and others, raise risks early, and follow through to verify what shipped behaves as expected.
• AI-Fluent Delivery:Practical experience using coding agents, agentic prompting, and MCP-style tooling across backend and frontend. You can articulate where AI accelerates you, where it misleads you, and how you validate its output.
• Communication and Collaboration:Clear, calibrated, and direct. Comfortable giving and receiving substantive feedback; able to disagree well and update your view when the evidence does.
Bonus Points For
• Experience leading a meaningful slice of a backend service, frontend platform, or design-system effort
• Experience with intricate workflows and high information-volume interfaces (operations consoles, control rooms, trading)
• Open-source contributions, particularly to BEAM-ecosystem projects or frontend tooling others depend on
• Experience with real-time data, event-driven UIs, or large-scale data visualisation
• Experience in greenfield or scaling-stage environments where you set patterns, not just follow them
• Exposure to logistics, supply chain tech, or integration-heavy domains (ERPs, TMSs, telematics)
Why You'll Love Working Here
• A Great Place to Work (Literally):Enjoy in-person collaboration4 days per week in our Tanjong Pagar office— close to great food, coffee, and transport.
• Real Engineering, Real Impact:You'll work on meaningful product challenges with direct line of sight to operational users — concurrency, real-time events, data orchestration, and clear UI all matter here.
• Shape What's Being Built:Our architecture is established but not rigid. There's room to grow into bigger problems as you progress, and to influence patterns as you do.
• Small Team, Big Autonomy:No bureaucracy. Direct line to product, design, and leadership. You get context, ownership, and visibility from day one.
• Growth With Meaning:This is a place for builders who want to leave a mark on something real. We use a published levels framework, so progression on craft, scope, and leadership is a real conversation — not a guessing game.

b.description:
Company Overview
Amperesand is reinventing how the world powers its most critical systems.
We are facing a once-in-a-generation opportunity for infrastructure disruption. Electricity demand is skyrocketing, driven by AI factories, electric vehicles, and modern industrial growth. Energy supply is shifting to incorporate a more diverse mix of resources – including solar, gas, and batteries – at a massive scale.
And yet the power infrastructure behind our latest mega-projects hasn’t meaningfully changed in nearly 100 years. Supply chains for today’s infrastructure equipment can’t match the pace and sophistication of critical energy projects. Amperesand is building hardware and software that rewrites this broken power infrastructure playbook to support a new era of energy abundance.
We’ve built a new class of intelligent, software-defined power infrastructure products leveraging a decade of advanced medium voltage Solid State Transformer research that’s now ready for commercial deployment.
Our products and solutions go far beyond the capabilities of traditional electrical equipment. We make power systems that are faster to deploy, dramatically smaller and more efficient, and capable of supporting modern, dynamic energy needs for tomorrow’s most demanding energy consumers.
Scalable in-house advanced manufacturing capability is our foundation for meeting timeline and quality expectation to serve infrastructure customers around the world.
Amperesand is led by breakthrough energy hardware development veterans and funded by top tier investors who share our vision of building a category-defining energy technology company.
With hubs in San Francisco, Reno, and Singapore, our global team is laser focused on building foundational technology to solve the most pressing problems in power infrastructure at scale.
Join us in building the power foundation of the future!
Role Summary
This role is an opportunity to work with a high-agency startup team operating in the hard-tech and energy systems space. You will play a critical role in designing, building, and shipping the full stack of Amperesand’s ERP platform, company intranet, and the internal tools that our manufacturing, supply chain, finance, and corporate teams rely on every day.
This is a hands-on role that spans the entire stack. You will design data models and backend services, then build the React and TypeScript interfaces that sit on top of them — owning features end to end from requirements through production. The work covers ERP domains such as inventory, procurement, work orders, and reporting, alongside intranet capabilities such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal workflows, approvals, and self-service tools. You will also help introduce AI-assisted capabilities into these products, such as natural-language search over internal knowledge, document summarization, and workflow assistance.
The role requires close collaboration with product, design, backend, and domain expert teams — along with a strong sense of ownership, product judgment, and pragmatism in building reliable software for real-world operations. Beyond building new capabilities, you will also own and support our existing software products in production — keeping them healthy, responsive, and continuously improving for the internal stakeholders and customers who depend on them daily. This is a fast-paced environment with a small team and a large surface area, so we are looking for a go-getter who takes initiative, moves with urgency, and is willing to put in the hard work to see things through. AI is a first-class part of this roadmap rather than a side project: you will design and ship AI-powered capabilities integrated directly into the products themselves, and help set the standard for how we build them responsibly on top of sensitive internal company data.
This role is open at either the Senior or Staff level. Senior engineers are expected to own significant features and systems end to end and lift the engineers around them. Staff engineers are expected to do that while also setting technical direction across the ERP, MES, and intranet platforms, leading initiatives that span multiple teams, and taking responsibility for the long-term health of the architecture. We will calibrate the level to your experience during the interview process.
Responsibilities
• Own the design, architecture, and delivery of full stack features across Amperesand’s ERP platform, intranet, and internal operational tools.
• Build and scale backend services in Go that support mission-critical manufacturing, supply chain, and enterprise business workflows.
• Build responsive, accessible, and performant web interfaces in React and TypeScript that make complex operational data understandable and actionable.
• Design robust APIs, service interfaces, and data models that serve web applications, analytics systems, internal tools, and third-party enterprise integrations.
• Deliver ERP capabilities spanning inventory management, procurement, supply chain operations, work order execution, production tracking, and enterprise reporting.
• Build intranet features such as employee directories, document and knowledge management, internal announcements, approval and request workflows, onboarding flows, and self-service portals.
• Integrate the intranet and ERP with internal systems such as identity and SSO providers, HR systems, document storage, and collaboration tools.
• Design, build, and ship AI-powered features directly into our ERP and intranet products — natural-language search and Q&A over company knowledge, document understanding and data extraction, summarization, exception and anomaly flagging, and assistant-style workflows that remove manual operational work.
• Build the backend foundations behind those features: retrieval and embedding pipelines, vector and hybrid search, context assembly from ERP and intranet data, prompt orchestration, and tool/function calling into existing services.
• Integrate LLM providers and AI services into production systems with attention to latency, cost, caching, rate limits, fallback behavior, and graceful degradation when a model is slow, unavailable, or wrong.
• Design AI experiences that fit enterprise software — streaming responses, citations back to source records, clear handling of uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop review before any action is committed to the system of record.
• Apply guardrails for AI operating on internal company data, including permission-aware retrieval, access control, PII handling, auditability, and prevention of data leakage across teams.
• Partner with the AI team to evaluate models, build eval sets and quality metrics, and take promising prototypes all the way into supported, production-grade product features.
• Continuously evaluate where AI can meaningfully reduce manual effort across ERP and intranet workflows — and where a conventional solution is the better answer.
• Support, maintain, and continuously improve our existing ERP, MES, and intranet software products in production — triaging issues, diagnosing root causes, and shipping fixes and enhancements alongside new feature development, including time-sensitive issues that block production on the shop floor.
• Serve as a technical point of contact for internal stakeholders and customers using our platforms, responding to requests, unblocking users, and turning their feedback into prioritized product improvements.
• Build systems that are reliable, observable, secure, and resilient under production load, with appropriate attention to authentication, authorization, and data privacy for internal enterprise data.
• Optimize performance across both frontend rendering and backend latency, throughput, and data access patterns.
• Collaborate closely with product, design, and domain teams to translate operational requirements into well-scoped, well-architected software.
• Drive best practices for code quality, testing, deployment, reliability, and maintainability across the stack.
• Contribute to — and at the Staff level, help set — technical strategy and architecture decisions across frontend, backend, data, and platform layers.
• Mentor other engineers through code reviews, design reviews, pairing, and strong engineering standards.
• Lead multi-quarter technical initiatives that cross team and system boundaries, breaking them into deliverable milestones and keeping them on track.
• Establish and evolve engineering standards, patterns, and shared foundations that raise the quality and velocity of the whole team.
• Act as a force multiplier: grow other engineers, improve how the team works, and step into the hardest or most ambiguous problems on the roadmap.
• Partner with leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to shape the ERP, MES, and intranet roadmap, and to make pragmatic build, buy, and sequencing calls.
• Leverage AI-assisted development tools where useful to improve engineering velocity, code quality, and developer productivity.
• Document designs, architecture decisions, and tradeoffs for cross-functional stakeholders.
Qualifications
• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building and shipping full stack web applications to production.
• Demonstrated technical leadership without formal authority — driving alignment on designs, raising the engineering bar, and unblocking others. At the Staff level, this includes owning the architecture of a major platform area end to end.
• Strong experience building production backend services, ideally in Go; strong engineers from other typed backend languages who are eager to work in Go are welcome.
• Strong frontend experience with React and TypeScript, including modern component patterns, state management, and building complex data-dense interfaces such as tables, forms, dashboards, and workflow builders.
• Solid understanding of API design, relational data modeling, authentication and authorization, and service integration patterns.
• Experience building enterprise or internal software such as ERP, MES, intranet, workflow, admin, or business operations platforms.
• Hands-on experience with Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) — building, extending, integrating with, or supporting them in a production manufacturing environment.
• Working knowledge of core MES domains such as work order and routing execution, electronic travelers and work instructions, WIP and production tracking, operator and station interfaces, labor and material consumption, and shop-floor data collection.
• Understanding of quality and traceability requirements in manufacturing software — in-process inspections, non-conformance and CAPA handling, serialization, unit genealogy, and as-built records.
• Familiarity with MES-to-ERP integration patterns, including synchronization of work orders, BOMs and routings, inventory and material movements, and production status between systems.
• Exposure to equipment and shop-floor integration — machine, PLC, SCADA, or IoT data collection — and to production metrics such as OEE, yield, cycle time, and downtime tracking.
• Experience with databases and data systems such as PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Redis, or similar technologies, including schema design and query optimization.
• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and containerized deployment environments such as AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker.
• Experience with observability and production operations, including logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and incident debugging.
• Strong testing discipline across unit, integration, and end-to-end validation.
• Comfortable working with AI coding tools such as Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools to supplement and accelerate development.
• Hands-on experience integrating LLM or AI APIs into production application features — such as retrieval-augmented search, summarization, structured data extraction, or tool-calling workflows — along with sound judgment about where AI is and is not the right solution.
